text: E-ANUDAAN DEMO SIGN-IN LISTS THE MAKER AND THE CHECKER. The demo dock's Sign in tab offered every E-Anudaan officer except the two PFMS payment seats, so the Payment Advice and Authorisation screens could only be reached by someone who knew their numbers. Maker — Programme Division (9200000813) and Checker — Programme Division (9200000814) now follow the Programme Division officers, on the estate's Demo@123; Use fills the Officer tab and each signs in to its own queue.
